_comment: Adds the 22 section Parts for the two 'Wind that Fanned the Flames' chapters of P&K, which are
an ontology of role-vignettes rather than single scenes. Each section is one unit of a mining
pass, which is what a Part is; a citation to 235,000 characters of 'chapter' is barely more
precise than citing the whole fic.
DELIBERATELY SCOPED TO P&K ONLY — do not merge this into source-material.v2.json and re-run
that. The live Part set has diverged from the original config on purpose (Brian merged the FiM
two-parters in-app: 216 Parts live against the config's 230), and seed-source-material re-stamps
Name/Description/OrderIndex on every Part it is given, so re-running the full config would
recreate the 14 merged episodes and undo that decision.
The Work row's description/partNoun/orderIndex below are the live values, so the upsert leaves
it byte-identical. Section names are the fic author's own headings, read out of the EPUB — the
same standing as the published-work descriptions seed-source-material already stamps, not
Brian's framing prose. ReviewState is set once on creation and never re-stamped, so a re-run
cannot un-review a section he has checked off.
Parent Parts ch121 and ch122 are left in place: ch122 already carries a citation, and deleting
Parts is authorial work this op cannot do. They hold no text of their own after the split, which
the ingest reports as 'split', not as missing.
